objectives.statement: Recognize and use no article after være and bli with professions and roles.
Use no article with languages, sports, mass nouns, transport expressions, and indefinite plurals.
Choose between no article and an indefinite article when Norwegian meaning requires it.

notes: Must teach the contexts where Norwegian uses no article: professions/roles after være/bli, mass nouns, languages, sports, and indefinite plurals. Contrast with English where an article is often required. Defer possession to genitive and definiteness to definite_articles.
